representation: readonly occurrence record with explicit construction

values.integer: exact signed 64-bit bigint; canonical decimal string or safe integer accepted at input
values.decimal: finite binary64 number, not exact decimal arithmetic
values.uuid_timestamp: nonempty text carriers; no format, chronology or uniqueness proof
values.reference: nonempty selector-indexed string carrier; no lookup, embedding or existence proof
values.optional: absent stays absent; present undefined or null is rejected

occurrence: explicit required field in a separate occurrence object; not Entity identity or payload equality

time.required: explicit occurredAt input, no clock parameter
time.generated: explicit synchronous clock parameter called once after input validation; no ambient clock

construction: copies and freezes occurrence, payload and outer record; event type and version come from checked source
effects: no publication, persistence, deduplication or occurrence registration; explicit clock execution only for generated policy
proof_ceiling: inert data in the ordinary realm; no arbitrary Proxy or modified intrinsic isolation
compatibility: opt-in compiler; existing source schema, references, profiles and default generators unchanged
